text: Testing is a critical part of software development, ensuring that code works as expected. Two main types of tests exist: unit tests, which check individual functions or components in isolation, and integration tests, which verify that different parts of the system work together correctly. A popular approach is test-driven development, where you write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to pass it, and finally refactor. This method encourages clean, reliable code. Ultimately, a good testing strategy gives developers confidence. When you know your tests cover the important parts, you can make changes and add new features without fear of breaking something that already works.
